name: Drill Guide Jig
description: 70 x 40 x 15 mm drill jig: three 6 mm guide bores with bushing counterbores, a registration fence, and two M5 clamp holes.

steps.instruction: Create the jig body: a block 70 mm long (X), 40 mm wide (Y) and 15 mm thick (Z), centered in X and Y with its base on Z=0.

transcript.user_prompt: Create the jig body: a block 70 mm long (X), 40 mm wide (Y) and 15 mm thick (Z), centered in X and Y with its base on Z=0.
transcript.assistant_message: I've created the 70 x 40 x 15 mm jig body — thick enough to guide a drill square to the work.

steps.instruction: Add a registration fence along the Y=-20 face: a bar 70 mm long (X), 8 mm wide (Y, from Y=-28 to Y=-20) and 12 mm tall, hanging from Z=4 down to Z=-8 so it hooks over the workpiece edge.

transcript.user_prompt: Add a registration fence along the Y=-20 face: a bar 70 mm long (X), 8 mm wide (Y, from Y=-28 to Y=-20) and 12 mm tall, hanging from Z=4 down to Z=-8 so it hooks over the workpiece edge.
transcript.assistant_message: I added the registration fence along the front face — it drops 8 mm below the base so the jig hooks square against the workpiece edge.

steps.instruction: Drill three 6 mm drill guide bores of radius 3 mm vertically through the body at X = -20, 0 and 20 on the Y=0 centreline.

transcript.user_prompt: Drill three 6 mm drill guide bores of radius 3 mm vertically through the body at X = -20, 0 and 20 on the Y=0 centreline.
transcript.assistant_message: I drilled the three 6 mm guide bores through the body at 20 mm spacing — these steer the drill bit.

steps.instruction: Counterbore each guide bore from the top for a press-fit bushing: radius 5 mm, 5 mm deep (from Z=10 to the top face at Z=15).

transcript.user_prompt: Counterbore each guide bore from the top for a press-fit bushing: radius 5 mm, 5 mm deep (from Z=10 to the top face at Z=15).
transcript.assistant_message: I counterbored all three guides 10 mm across and 5 mm deep so hardened drill bushings can be pressed in from the top.

steps.instruction: Drill two M5 clamp holes of radius 2.75 mm vertically through the body at X = +/-30 on the Y=0 centreline.

transcript.user_prompt: Drill two M5 clamp holes of radius 2.75 mm vertically through the body at X = +/-30 on the Y=0 centreline.
transcript.assistant_message: I drilled the two 5.5 mm clamp holes at the ends of the jig — toggle clamps or screws hold it to the work through these.
